issue_context.title: Sensibo integration does not expose air quality for "Sensibo AirQ" devices
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I recently got a new sensibo AirQ device and it works fine with the cloud API integration. But it does not expose the air quality properties (TVOC and CO2). This would be really nice to have displayed in HA.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.6.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

sensibo

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sensibo/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_
